deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue KPI dashboard development toward live on-chain Cardano data tracking.
Use an independent multisig administrator to validate milestones before Cardano Builder DAO receives funds.
Return unused or unallocated funds to the Cardano Treasury.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with treasury withdrawal received and administered by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism for Cardano builders aligned to Vision 2030 KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism to support projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs such as MAU, transactions, and TVL.
The proposal states that funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 2 moving toward KPI tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 allegedly included 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, 83% governance participation, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 allegedly added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The proposal says the DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed on-chain treasury withdrawals transparently.

The proposal states that official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.

The administrator will keep ADA in separate auditable accounts, avoid stake pool delegation, delegate voting power to the predefined abstain option, and disburse funds only after milestone validation.
The CB DAO says it returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after the first two governance rounds, citing an AdaStat transaction URL.

summary: The proposal requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue a KPI-driven, smart contract-governed builder funding mechanism with independent administration, milestone validation, KPI reporting, and repayment of unused funds.
